content.answer: Fix rule: never rebuild a single-select field's options from just the target list of names — merge by stable id: keep every existing option object (its old id) untouched for names that already exist, and only assign fresh ids to genuinely new names, continuing from max(existing id)+1; rebuilding the list by name alone makes the API regenerate all ids and silently clears every existing row's references.
content.reuse_advice: For any update to an id-referenced catalog (select fields, statuses, tags, etc.), always merge rather than replace: fetch the current options, pass existing entries through with their original ids, add only truly new entries with new ids after max(existing id)+1, and never regenerate the catalog from names alone — id regeneration silently breaks every row that references the old ids.
